media_scope: No tracked binary assets/videos. External marketing logos/social icons/contributor banner and dynamic badges not fetched; no claim of reviewing linked external sites or repositories.
license: Complete AGPL3 LICENSE read; no production code copied.
native_scope: Complete unchanged run_repo/init modules, actual Python filesystem/set/statistics and GitPython3.1.46 cloning only own local Git repositories. No API/body adapters, no remote network clone, config global/system disabled in own process.19scenarios twice.
findings: Case-insensitive literal lines and comments treated as matches; repeats collapse per filepair andmultiply across files. Destination suffix notchecked; ignored prefixes suppress real identifiers.
All UTF8 nonblacklisted file types and hidden .git files scanned; owned symlink follows sibling outside scan root.
Existing clonedirectory notvalidated/refreshed; failed clone leaves directory then futurecalls silently reuse it. Custom comparisons print hardcoded repositorylabels.
decision: Reject line-copy statistics as exact/image identity. Reference explicit pair-vs-line count contracts and snapshot freshness; no production adoption or speed claim.
limits: No upstream tests in pinned tree; no real remoteGit repositories, history/provenance/attribution, dependency-source/security, performance or production adoption qualification.
Line intersection is not file-byte/image identity or semantic code-copy evidence. Case/whitespace normalization deliberately part of algorithm.
Complete pinned source review excludes thirdpartyGitPython/dependency-source and linked external marketing assets.
